name: Unbreakable Kimmy Schmidt
description: When a woman is rescued from a doomsday cult and lands in New York City, she must navigate a world she didn't think even existed anymore.

videos.title: Kimmy Goes Outside!
videos.overview: Imprisoned by a cult leader as a teenager, Midwesterner Kimmy is freed after 15 years. The first thing she decides to do is move to New York.

videos.title: Kimmy Gets a Job!
videos.overview: Kimmy has to throw an acceptable kids' birthday party to keep her new job with the filthy rich Voorhees family.

videos.title: Kimmy Goes on a Date!
videos.overview: Kimmy and Jacqueline try to hide their pasts, while Titus lies to Lillian about money so he can spend it on headshots for his future.

videos.title: Kimmy Goes to the Doctor!
videos.overview: Kimmy has an eye-opening experience when Jacqueline introduces her to her plastic surgeon. Titus auditions for a Spider-Man musical.

videos.title: Kimmy Kisses a Boy!
videos.overview: Kimmy's bunker-mate Cyndee visits New York with her new boyfriend, Brandon, whom Titus promptly outs. Charles makes his move with Kimmy.

videos.title: Kimmy Goes to School!
videos.overview: Kimmy's GED class isn't as educational as she'd hoped. Lillian helps Titus shoot a music video ... in Jacqueline's house.

videos.title: Kimmy Goes to a Party!
videos.overview: Jacqueline asks Kimmy to help her plan a dinner party where Jacqueline can confirm if her husband, Julian, is cheating on her.

videos.title: Kimmy Is Bad at Math!
videos.overview: Dong tries to teach Kimmy math and Kimmy tries to convince Jacqueline to get a divorce.

videos.title: Kimmy Has a Birthday!
videos.overview: Kimmy's 30th birthday party isn't quite the fun celebration of adulthood she wants it to be.

videos.title: Kimmy's in a Love Triangle!
videos.overview: Kimmy is torn between two guys and trying not to act like a fool. Titus finds a different kind of acting coach.

videos.title: Kimmy Rides a Bike!
videos.overview: Titus can't stop watching the trial of Kimmy's charismatic kidnapper on the Internet, while Kimmy turns to exercise to avoid testifying.

videos.title: Kimmy Goes to Court!
videos.overview: Kimmy and Titus go back to Durnsville, Indiana so Kimmy can testify against the Reverend Wayne, but the trip doesn't go very well.

videos.title: Kimmy Makes Waffles!
videos.overview: Kimmy is stuck in Durnsville. Jacqueline gets back in touch with her roots when she and Lillian drive to Indiana to find Kimmy.

videos.title: Kimmy Goes Roller Skating!
videos.overview: Titus's ex-wife sues him for spousal support. Kimmy still has feelings for Dong. Jacqueline's Sioux family gets fed up with her.

videos.title: Kimmy Goes on a Playdate!
videos.overview: Kimmy helps Jacqueline put her life back together after the divorce. Titus donates his old clothes and makes a connection with a construction worker.

videos.title: Kimmy Goes to a Play!
videos.overview: Titus develops a one-man show about his past life as a geisha. While Jacqueline tries to make Julian jealous, Lillian battles gentrification.

videos.title: Kimmy Kidnaps Gretchen!
videos.overview: Kimmy stages an intervention when ex-mole woman Gretchen joins another cult. Titus takes Mikey the construction worker on his first gay date.

videos.title: Kimmy Gives Up!
videos.overview: Kimmy needs to study for the GED, but she's worried about Dong getting deported. Jacqueline puts Buckley on Dyziplen to treat his hyperactivity.

videos.title: Kimmy Drives a Car!
videos.overview: Hipsters invade the neighborhood when Titus rents his apartment on Airbnb. Kimmy finally reaches her limit with Jacqueline's self-centered attitude.

videos.title: Kimmy Walks Into a Bar!
videos.overview: Jacqueline's gala plans hit a snag when Deirdre Robespierre throws a party the same night. Kimmy stops to pee at a bar and meets a cute Army vet.

videos.title: Kimmy Goes to a Hotel!
videos.overview: On Fake Christmas, Kimmy and Dong take a trip to the Poconos, and a Jewish family claims that Jacqueline's prized Mondrian is rightfully theirs.

videos.title: Kimmy Meets a Drunk Lady!
videos.overview: A drunk Uber passenger convinces Kimmy to stop repressing her emotions. Meanwhile, a broken R. Kelly cassette tape pushes Titus over the edge.

videos.title: Kimmy Goes to Her Happy Place!
videos.overview: Kimmy has her first therapy session with Andrea, but it's Lillian who helps her get in touch with her anger. Mikey comes out to his family.

videos.title: Kimmy Meets a Celebrity!
videos.overview: A celebrity psychologist with a TV talk show drives a wedge between Kimmy and her former bunker-mate Cyndee. Titus gives a teenage boy dating advice.

videos.title: Kimmy Sees a Sunset!
videos.overview: Kimmy tries to help Andrea with her drinking problem. Jacqueline dates a pro bono lawyer for his money. Titus and Mikey talk about moving in together.

videos.title: Kimmy Finds Her Mom!
videos.overview: While Kimmy reunites with her mom at Universal Studios, Titus heads to Miami. Jacqueline invites Russ and his family to Thanksgiving dinner.

videos.title: Kimmy Gets Divorced?!
videos.overview: Back in New York, Titus goes to great lengths to score an audition for "Sesame Street." Jacqueline encourages Kimmy to play hardball with the Reverend.

videos.title: Kimmy's Roommate Lemonades!
videos.overview: Titus unleashes his inner Beyoncé when he suspects Mikey of cheating. Kimmy checks out colleges, and Jacqueline and Lillian clash over city politics.

videos.title: Kimmy Can't Help You!
videos.overview: A surprise visitor delivers divorce papers to Kimmy. Jacqueline comes up with a plan to get Russ's dad to rename the Redskins.

videos.title: Kimmy Goes to College!
videos.overview: Kimmy makes a splash at Columbia University while doing odd jobs to save up for college. Titus sings backup for a controversial musician.

videos.title: Kimmy Steps on a Crack!
videos.overview: The FBI enlists Kimmy's help when former mole woman Gretchen tries to start a cult of her own. Titus is stricken with a strange disease.

videos.title: Kimmy Is a Feminist!
videos.overview: Kimmy goes to her first college party with her new friends. Jacqueline calls Titus for backup when Russ's brother puts the moves on her.

videos.title: Kimmy Learns About the Weather!
videos.overview: Titus goes after big pharma when a drug company steals his likeness. Lillian convinces Kimmy that the weatherman can't be trusted.

videos.title: Kimmy Does a Puzzle!
videos.overview: Titus makes a shocking confession about the cruise. When a hurricane hits, Kimmy turns their apartment into a "fun-ker" filled with games and puzzles.

videos.title: Kimmy Goes to Church!
videos.overview: Titus takes Kimmy to church on Good Friday, where they tangle with an elderly busybody. Jacqueline gives Lillian a makeover for Passover.

videos.title: Kimmy Pulls Off a Heist!
videos.overview: Kimmy and Titus get in over their heads when they steal a gas station bathroom key. Jacqueline plots to infiltrate the NFL owners' meeting.

videos.title: Kimmy Googles the Internet!
videos.overview: Kimmy discovers the humiliating power of the internet. Titus wonders if he's compatible with Reuben. Jacqueline takes care of Mimi after butt surgery.

videos.title: Kimmy and the Trolley Problem!
videos.overview: Russ's transformation opens doors for Jacqueline. Kimmy wrestles with a philosophical dilemma. Artie invites Lillian on a European cruise

videos.title: Kimmy Bites an Onion!
videos.overview: Kimmy decides to become a crossing guard. Buoyed by the success of "Boobs in California," Titus tries to win back Mikey with help from Jacqueline.

videos.title: Kimmy Is... Little Girl, Big City!
videos.overview: Hoping to win Mikey back, Titus pretends he's starring in a TV show. As the new head of HR at Giztoob, Kimmy has to fire an employee.

videos.title: Kimmy Has a Weekend!
videos.overview: Kimmy and Titus spend the weekend binge watching TV and getting their nails done. Jacqueline schemes to evict her wealthy subletter.

videos.title: Party Monster: Scratching the Surface
videos.overview: In the probing documentary "Party Monster," DJ Fingablast investigates what became of his childhood hero, DJ Slizzard.

videos.title: Kimmy Disrupts the Paradigm!
videos.overview: Kimmy tackles sexism at a tech conference while Lillian hits on men. Titus auditions for an acting troupe and researches nerds for a role.

videos.title: Kimmy and the Beest!
videos.overview: Titus directs a school musical but misses being in the spotlight. Jacqueline and Lillian try to scalp tickets to parents. Kimmy confronts a blogger.

videos.title: Kimmy Meets an Old Friend!
videos.overview: Titus struggles to come up with a pitch for "The Capist." Kimmy writes a children's book. Lillian meets Artie's kids. Jacqueline stands up for Xan.

videos.title: Kimmy Fights a Fire Monster!
videos.overview: A beefcake hits on Titus, Jacqueline enjoys attention from millennial men, and Kimmy catches up with ex-mole woman Donna Maria.

videos.title: Kimmy Is in a Love Square!
videos.overview: Titus opens up about his encounter with Mr. Frumpus. Kimmy bonds with her date's parents and starts seeing them behind his back.

videos.title: Sliding Van Doors
videos.overview: What would life be like if Kimmy never got in the Reverend's van and Titus missed his audition for "The Lion King"?

videos.title: Kimmy Finds a Liar!
videos.overview: Kimmy discovers that Fran Dodd is posing as the author of her book. Jacqueline sets Titus up in a fake relationship with a celebrity.

videos.title: Kimmy Is Rich*!
videos.overview: When Zach sells Giztoob for big bucks, Kimmy celebrates! Jacqueline hustles to keep Tripp as a client, and Titus learns a secret about "Cats."

videos.title: Kimmy Says Bye!
videos.overview: Titus is torn between living his dream and winning back Mikey. Lillian takes a final stand against gentrification. Kimmy has an influential fan.

awards: Nominated for 18 Primetime Emmys. 25 wins & 98 nominations total
